parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto'); const headers=$json.headers||{}, query=$json.query||{}, body=$json.body||{}; const initData=headers['x-telegram-init-data']||headers['X-Telegram-Init-Data']||query.initData||query.init_data||null; if(!initData)throw new Error('INIT_DATA_MISSING'); const token=$env.MONEYTRACK_BOT_TOKEN; if(!token)throw new Error('BOT_TOKEN_MISSING'); const params={}; for(const part of initData.split('&')){const i=part.indexOf('=');if(i<0)continue;params[decodeURIComponent(part.slice(0,i))]=decodeURIComponent(part.slice(i+1));} const received=params.hash;if(!received)throw new Error('HASH_MISSING');delete params.hash;const check=Object.keys(params).sort().map(k=>`${k}=${params[k]}`).join('\n');const secret=crypto.createHmac('sha256','WebAppData').update(token).digest();if(crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(check).digest('hex')!==received)throw new Error('INVALID_INIT_DATA_HASH');const user=JSON.parse(params.user||'{}');if(!user.id)throw new Error('USER_MISSING');const id=String(body.id||'').trim();if(!/^\d+$/.test(id))throw new Error('PRESET_ID_INVALID');const name=String(body.name||'').trim();if(!name||name.length>80)throw new Error('PRESET_NAME_INVALID');return [{json:{telegram_user_id:user.id,preset_id:Number(id),name}}];

const crypto=require('crypto'); const headers=$json.headers||{}, query=$json.query||{}; const initData=headers['x-telegram-init-data']||headers['X-Telegram-Init-Data']||query.initData||query.init_data||null;if(!initData)throw new Error('INIT_DATA_MISSING');const token=$env.MONEYTRACK_BOT_TOKEN;if(!token)throw new Error('BOT_TOKEN_MISSING');const params={};for(const part of initData.split('&')){const i=part.indexOf('=');if(i<0)continue;params[decodeURIComponent(part.slice(0,i))]=decodeURIComponent(part.slice(i+1));}const received=params.hash;if(!received)throw new Error('HASH_MISSING');delete params.hash;const check=Object.keys(params).sort().map(k=>`${k}=${params[k]}`).join('\n');const secret=crypto.createHmac('sha256','WebAppData').update(token).digest();if(crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(check).digest('hex')!==received)throw new Error('INVALID_INIT_DATA_HASH');const user=JSON.parse(params.user||'{}');if(!user.id)throw new Error('USER_MISSING');const id=String(query.id||'').trim();if(!/^\d+$/.test(id))throw new Error('PRESET_ID_INVALID');return [{json:{telegram_user_id:user.id,preset_id:Number(id)}}];

parameters.query: with user_ctx as (select id as user_id from moneytrack.app_users where telegram_user_id={{$json.telegram_user_id}}::bigint limit 1) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.name,'account_ids',p.account_ids,'income_category_ids',p.income_category_ids,'expense_category_ids',p.expense_category_ids,'created_at',p.created_at) order by p.created_at,p.id),'[]'::jsonb) as presets from user_ctx u left join moneytrack.filter_presets p on p.user_id=u.user_id;

with user_ctx as (select id as user_id from moneytrack.app_users where telegram_user_id={{$json.telegram_user_id}}::bigint limit 1), ins as (insert into moneytrack.filter_presets(user_id,name,account_ids,income_category_ids,expense_category_ids) select user_id,'{{$json.name.replace(/'/g, "''")}}',ARRAY[{{$json.account_ids.join(',')}}]::bigint[],ARRAY[{{$json.income_category_ids.join(',')}}]::bigint[],ARRAY[{{$json.expense_category_ids.join(',')}}]::bigint[] from user_ctx returning *) select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'account_ids',account_ids,'income_category_ids',income_category_ids,'expense_category_ids',expense_category_ids,'created_at',created_at) as preset from ins;

with user_ctx as (select id as user_id from moneytrack.app_users where telegram_user_id={{$json.telegram_user_id}}::bigint limit 1), upd as (update moneytrack.filter_presets p set name='{{$json.name.replace(/'/g, "''")}}' from user_ctx u where p.id={{$json.preset_id}}::bigint and p.user_id=u.user_id returning p.*) select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'account_ids',account_ids,'income_category_ids',income_category_ids,'expense_category_ids',expense_category_ids,'created_at',created_at) as preset from upd;

with user_ctx as (select id as user_id from moneytrack.app_users where telegram_user_id={{$json.telegram_user_id}}::bigint limit 1), del as (delete from moneytrack.filter_presets p using user_ctx u where p.id={{$json.preset_id}}::bigint and p.user_id=u.user_id returning p.id) select coalesce((select id from del limit 1),0)::bigint as deleted_id;
